parameters.name: Direction
parameters.description:
Synchronization job direction. Valid values:

- ingress: inbound

- egress: outbound

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: Synchronization end time in Unix timestamp format, in milliseconds.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: Number of rows per page for paginated queries. Maximum value: 100.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: Token for querying the next page. This parameter is not returned when there are no more pages.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: Synchronization start time in Unix timestamp format, in milliseconds.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
Synchronization job status. Valid values:

- pending: initial state

- running: running

- failed: failed

- partial_success: partially succeeded

- success: succeeded

parameters.name: TargetType
parameters.description:
Synchronization target type. Valid values:

- identity_provider: identity provider

- application: application
